title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Whisk eggs and parmesan together in a bowl.
Drain spaghetti and mix with pancetta.
Quickly stir in egg mixture off the heat.
Serve with extra parmesan and black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked.
Fry onion, then add tomato puree and simmer.
Add cream and stir until sauce thickens.
Mix in chicken pieces and cook for 10 mins.
Serve hot with rice or naan.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Simple and healthy toast topped with smashed avocado and seasonings.
